extracted.name: Old-Fashioned Hot Buttered Rum
extracted.description: This is a genuine old-fashioned hot buttered rum recipe, except you use a slow cooker to simmer it. You’ll think you are drinking a cinnamon roll.
instruction_lines: Combine hot water, brown sugar, butter, and salt in a 5-quart slow cooker; add cloves and cinnamon sticks.
Cover slow cooker. Cook on Low for 5 hours. Stir in rum.
Ladle buttered rum into mugs. Top with whipped cream; sprinkle with nutmeg.
